findings.current: “Don’t remind me. They dared to steal government uniforms from somewhere and disrupt the order of the Great Nation.”
findings.defect: The draft omits that the martial artists wore the stolen government uniforms, removing the disguise action central to the City Lord’s complaint.
findings.rationale: 훔쳐 입고 explicitly means that they stole the uniforms and wore them.
findings.replacement: “Don’t remind me. They dared to steal government uniforms from who knows where, put them on, and disrupt the order of the Great Nation.”
findings.source: 어디서 구했는지 감히 관군의 복식까지 훔쳐 입고 대국의 질서를 어지럽히다니.

findings.current: “I told you before we departed. In front of anyone other than the Fire King and Cheongpung, you are to address me as Mungyeong.”
findings.defect: The draft narrows Mungyeong’s instruction to using his name, when he is telling Taekyung to treat him according to his Mungyeong persona, including the appropriate speech hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 문경으로 대하라고 means to treat or interact with him as Mungyeong, which explains Taekyung’s immediate objection to Mungyeong speaking informally.
findings.replacement: “I told you before we departed. In front of anyone other than the Fire King and Cheongpung, you are to treat me as Mungyeong.”
findings.source: “출발할 때 말했을 텐데. 화왕과 청풍을 제외한 다른 사람 앞에서는 문경으로 대하라고.”

findings.current: His favorite concubine threw back her head and laughed.
findings.defect: The draft adds the unsupported physical action of throwing back her head.
findings.rationale: The source specifies audible laughter but says nothing about her head or posture.

findings.defect: The generic paraphrase removes the deliberately crude fart comparison and its humor.
findings.rationale: 말인가 방귀인가 explicitly contrasts speech with a fart as an insulting comic reaction.

findings.current: “Nothing. I thought I heard some crazy woman laughing just now.”
findings.defect: The draft sanitizes the strongly derogatory 미친년, weakening Taekyung’s blunt register and the transition’s dark humor.
findings.rationale: 미친년 is explicitly profane and is stronger than “crazy woman.”
findings.replacement: “Nothing. I thought I heard some crazy bitch laughing just now.”
findings.source: “아니, 방금 무슨 미친년 웃는 소리를 들은 것 같아서.”

findings.current: His voice was desperate. But the concubine caught the City Lord’s hand as it reached to stroke her body.
findings.defect: “Stroke” softens the explicitly sexual, intrusive action conveyed by 더듬어 오는.
findings.rationale: 더듬다 in this sexual context means to grope or fondle, not merely to stroke.
findings.replacement: His voice was desperate. But the concubine caught the City Lord’s hand as it reached over to grope her body.
findings.source: 간절한 목소리. 하지만 애첩은 자신의 몸을 더듬어 오는 사천성주의 손길을 붙잡았다.

findings.defect: The missing exclamation mark flattens Mungyeong’s shocked reaction and weakens the comic beat before Taekyung’s apology.
findings.rationale: The source’s ……! signals stunned offense rather than a neutral silence.

findings.current:
“What business is it of yours?”

“…”

This was surprisingly fun.
findings.defect: The draft again removes Mungyeong’s emphatic, affronted reaction, dulling the repeated joke.
findings.rationale: The exclamation in ……! is the reaction that makes Taekyung find the exchange amusing.
findings.replacement:
“What business is it of yours?”

“…!”

This was surprisingly fun.
findings.source:
“네가 알아서 뭐 하게.”

“……!”

이거 은근히 재밌네.

findings.current:
“I’m going to take a nap. Don’t wake me.”

“…”
findings.defect: The draft changes Mungyeong’s puzzled reaction into an unmarked silence.
findings.rationale: The source question mark explicitly shows confusion and supports the transition to Taekyung’s private meaning of awakening from a long sleep.
findings.replacement:
“I’m going to take a nap. Don’t wake me.”

“…?”

findings.current: Though the government and Murim were mutually noninterfering domains that treated each other as though they were none of their business, well over a thousand people had died throughout Sichuan over the past seven days and nights.
findings.defect: The clause is grammatically strained: abstract “domains” are made to treat each other as though “they” were none of their business.
findings.rationale: This naturally preserves both 상호 불가침의 영역 and the 소 닭 보듯 image’s meaning of mutual indifference.
findings.replacement: Though the government and Murim occupied mutually noninterfering spheres and generally ignored each other, well over a thousand people had died throughout Sichuan over the past seven days and nights.
findings.source: 비록 관과 무림이 서로를 소 닭 보듯 하는 상호 불가침의 영역이라고는 하지만, 지난 칠 주야 동안 천 명이 훌쩍 넘는 사람들이 사천 땅 곳곳에서 죽어 나갔다.

findings.current: Splash! Gasp! Captain, save me! Gasp!
findings.defect: The draft completes the plea, losing the joke that the speaker is cut off by being dunked again mid-sentence.
findings.rationale: The comma after 살려 and the immediate 푸하 indicate an interrupted cry rather than a completed exclamation.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it omits one material disguise action, narrows Mungyeong’s identity-management instruction, softens profanity and sexual conduct, adds an unsupported physical action, and loses several comedic pragmatic cues.
